_doc: Conversation trees for conversation.gd (see its header for the format). speakers: nameplates, colours, typing voices. ash: Ash's own little lines (by person in ash.by). farewell / wrap_up / interrupts: how the other ends a talk. trees: quest beats (on offer:<quest> / step:<quest>:<n>), everyday trees (on talk, with a person, chance, once / daily), scenes (on scene). Plain lines are the other person; 'A: ' is Ash, 'N: ' narration, '<id>: ' someone else.

ask_clue: Hey, do you know anything about this?
Can I ask you about something I'm doing?
I'm helping someone. Do you know anything?
cond_wet: Heh. I sort of fell in. Sort of on purpose.
It's just water! It'll dry. Probably.
I was checking how deep it was. Pretty deep!
cond_fatigue: I'm fine! I'm just... catching my breath.
I ran here! The whole way! Heh...

lily: Bye! Nibbles says bye too. Probably.
See you! Don't catch anything before me!
rose: Mind the borders on your way out, dear.
Come back when the sweet peas are out.
ada: Bye, dear! I'll tell everyone you said hello!
Off you go! Tell your mother I said hi!
timmy: See you! I'm gonna practise my throw!
mae: Off you trot. Come back for a biscuit.
kai: Catch you on the next tide!
tom: Off with you, then. Steady as she goes.
oak: Run along, Ash. And no tall grass!
Come back any time, my boy.

_any: Well, I'd best get on. Come and find me later, Ash.
Goodness, look at us chatting! I've things to do, Ash.
delia: Oh, listen to us! I'd better get back to it, sweetie. More later?
timmy: Okay I gotta go do a secret thing now! BYE!
ben: Mm. Enough talk. Wheat won't cut itself.
gus: That's enough words for one day. Logged.
oak: My boy, I could talk POKéMON all day. And I would! But my notes are waiting.

_any: Oh! Is that the time? I have to run, Ash. We'll talk later!
delia: Oh! The terrace! I have to go, sweetie. Mr. Mime will be doing the dishes in mime again.
Oh, look at the time! Talk later, honey. Love you!
lily: Oh no, I'm late! Mom said be home! BYE!
rose: Ah, the flowers won't wait, Ash. Neither will I, I'm afraid.
bram: The ovens! HO! Sorry, lad, I have to run!
ada: Oh! My round! Everyone will be waiting for their loaves! Bye, dear!
timmy: Uh oh. That's my mom's voice. I gotta go!
mae: Oh, the Pidgey will be wanting me, dearie. Another time.
kai: Oops, that's my tide! Gotta go, kiddo!
marina: That's me. Work to do. Later, Ash.
tom: Ah, that's my cue, lad. The porch is calling.
gus: The lamp, Ash. I have to see to the lamp.
nibbles: N: (Nibbles hears Lily calling and wriggles off after her.)
doduo: N: (Both heads turn to Farmer Ben at once. Doduo trots off after him.)
mrmime: N: (Mr. Mime checks an invisible watch, bows, and hurries after Delia.)

nibbles: N: (Nibbles wriggles up onto Lily's shoe to get a better look at you.)
N: (At Lily's feet, Nibbles nods along as if he understands every word.)
doduo: N: (Doduo's left head pecks your cap. The right head looks embarrassed.)
N: (Doduo leans both heads in to listen. They seem to be taking notes.)
mrmime: N: (Behind Mom, Mr. Mime mimes everything she says. Very accurately.)
N: (Mr. Mime mimes handing you an invisible cup of tea. You take it, to be polite.)

lines: Kiddo! Settle something. Marina says I love this radio more than her. Is that true? Be honest.

choices.label: Yes. Definitely the radio.
choices.ash: Yes. Definitely the radio.

choices.label: You should tell her you don't.
choices.ash: You should go tell her you don't. Like, right now.

choices.label: Can I have the radio, then?
choices.ash: If you love her more... can I have the radio?

lines: Ha! TRAITOR! ...Don't tell her you said that. She'll agree with you.
Right now? ...You're right. You're right! I'm going to tell her! Right after the weather report.
Nice try! Technology is incredible, and it's MINE.
Ash. This one's wilting. Look. Too much sun, not enough water. What would you do?

choices.ash: Water it! Lots and lots!

Ha! You're more right than you know. You watch, and it tells you. Try that with your POKéMON.
When you're famous, dear, we'll put up a sign. 'Home of Ash Ketchum'. I'll paint it myself!

Oh, you dear boy. 'Home of Ash Ketchum, and his mother Delia, who did most of the work'. It'll be a long sign.
N: (Farmer Ben just looks at the field. He seems happy to stand there.)

choices.label: Say something!
choices.ash: So! Wheat! Pretty great, huh?

lines: N: (A Pidgey lands on the fence. The wheat moves in the wind. Neither of you says anything for a long time.)
Mm. Good talk.
Mm. Pretty great.
Back again, lad? Still thinking about that shake? I know I am.
Ash, lad! Did you feel it? Ground shook in the night. My ship's bell rang on its own.
That's the old mountain on Cinnabar, I'd wager. South across the sea.
Do an old sailor a favour. Ask Gus up at the lighthouse what he saw last night.
And ask Kai or Marina what the sailors are saying. Then come tell me.

choices.label: I'll find out! Leave it to me!
choices.ash: Leave it to me! I'll be back before you know it!

choices.label: Was it a giant POKéMON?

choices.label: Maybe later, Old Tom.
choices.ash: Can it wait a bit? I've got stuff to do.

lines: Ha! That's what I told Timmy. He's been hiding under the table since breakfast.

choices.label: Okay! Gus, then Kai or Marina.
choices.ash: Okay! Gus first, then Kai or Marina!

choices.label: Later, I promise.
choices.ash: Later, I promise.

lines: That's the spirit! Off you go. And don't let Gus bore you with his logbook.
A promise, eh? I'll hold you to it. The mountain isn't going anywhere.
The shake? Logged it. One-oh-five in the morning. Eleven seconds.

choices.label: You were AWAKE at one?
choices.ash: You were awake at one in the morning?

choices.label: What did you see?
choices.ash: What did you see from up there?

lines: I'm always awake at one, Ash. That's the job. The town sleeps. I watch.
From the gallery I saw a red glow, low on the southern horizon. Cinnabar.
Smoke at dawn, too. Thin and white. Tell Tom it wasn't his imagination. This time.
The rumbles? Ferry radio was buzzing about it! Technology is incredible!
The Cinnabar boats say the hot springs are bubbling extra hot. Tourists love it.

choices.label: Can I hear the radio?
choices.ash: Can I listen to the radio? Please?

choices.label: Is anyone in danger?
choices.ash: Is anyone in danger over there?

lines: N: (Kai turns a dial. Static. A crackle. Someone far away says 'over'.)
Hear that? That's a boat off Seafoam! INCREDIBLE!
Nah. Cinnabar folk are used to it. The old mountain grumbles, they make tea. Good of you to ask, though.
And the Gym's closed. Again. Blaine's a funny one, they say. Ask Tom about him.
The sailors? Jumpy. Tentacool scattered off the point like someone kicked the sea.
Water's warm. Warm from the south. That's Cinnabar's mountain, sure as salt.

choices.label: Can POKéMON feel earthquakes?
choices.ash: Can POKéMON feel it before it happens?

choices.label: Cool! A real volcano!
choices.ash: Cool! A real live volcano!

lines: Better than we can. The Krabby were all out of the water an hour before. Watch the POKéMON, Ash. They know.
Cool till it's your boat, kid. Respect the sea. And anything that boils it.
Ferry men say Blaine's gym is shut up tight. Ask Old Tom about that one.
Well, lad? Out with it! What did they say?

choices.label: A red glow AND smoke!
choices.ash: A red glow! And smoke at dawn! And the water's warm, and the Tentacool ran away!

choices.label: Gus says it's not your imagination.
choices.ash: Gus says to tell you it wasn't your imagination. This time.

choices.label: Are you worried, Old Tom?
choices.ash: Are you worried? About the mountain?

lines: 'This time'! HA! That old lamp-polisher. Fine. Fine! Score one for Gus.
Worried? ...A little, lad. I've friends on Cinnabar. Kind of you to ask an old man that.
A red glow, smoke at dawn, warm water and jumpy Tentacool. Ha! I knew it.
The old mountain's stirring, lad. Not angry, I'd say. Restless.
And the Gym's shut, eh? That'll be Blaine. Let me tell you about Blaine...
Fire POKéMON, a bald head, dark glasses, and a riddle for everyone who knocks.
They say his gym's hard to find. You'd need a clever head to get in. You'd do it, lad.
Ash! Have you got a minute now, dear? The wheel's no better. Neither is Bram.
Ash! Oh, thank goodness. The cart's wheel's gone all wobbly. Bram's on it, but he's slow.
Be a dear and tell Granny Mae, Rose and Farmer Ben their bread will be late today?

choices.label: Sure! I'm super fast!

choices.label: What's in it for me?
choices.ash: Okay... but what's in it for me?

choices.label: Not right now, sorry.
choices.ash: Not right now, sorry. Later?

choices.label: Deal!
choices.ash: Deal! Mae, Rose and Ben!

choices.label: I'd do it anyway. Sorry.
choices.ash: I was joking. I'd do it anyway. Sorry, Ada.

Mae will worry, Rose won't mind, and Ben will say 'Mm'. Then come back for a treat!
Of course, dear. The bread will be late either way! Ha!
Mm.

choices.label: Your bread's going to be late!

choices.ash: Ada bet me you'd say 'Mm'. Your bread's late.

...Thanks for telling me. Tell Ada the wheat's good this year.

Ash, dearie. You've got your errand face on.

choices.label: Your bread will be late, sorry.
choices.ash: Your bread's going to be late today. Sorry, Granny Mae.

choices.label: Bread emergency!
choices.ash: Bread emergency! Ada's wheel broke!

lines: 'Mm'? I KNEW it. You're a treasure, Ash!

Here, a honey roll, still warm. Don't tell Bram.

choices.label: I'll track it down!

The Ash Ketchum Fan Club is OFFICIAL! This is the best day EVER!
Ash. The favour still stands. The nights are still long.

Bram's bread would make them shorter. He bakes in the mornings, before the ovens go cold.

choices.label: I'll bring you a loaf!
choices.ash: I'll bring you a loaf! A warm one!

choices.label: Can I see the lamp?
choices.ash: Can I come up and see the lamp, too?

choices.label: Later, Gus.
choices.ash: Later, Gus. Okay?

lines: If you bring bread, you can see the lamp. Fair trade. Logged.

choices.label: Give him the burnt corner!
choices.ash: Give him one with a burnt corner! He likes those.

lines: You know him well! A burnt corner it is. 'Character', lad. That's what it is.
Every night, eh? Then my best rye. And a little honey on the side. Don't tell Ada.
Here. Fresh rye, still warm. Keep it wrapped till dark. Bread's best by lamplight, he says.
Bram's rye. At the top of the tower, with the lamp turning. Thank you, Ash.

choices.label: I don't hear anything...
choices.ash: I don't hear anything...

choices.label: Is it a ghost POKéMON?!
choices.ash: Is it a ghost POKéMON?!

choices.label: I can handle it!
choices.ash: I can handle it, Professor! I'm ten now!
